title: Hot air balloon with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a8a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8354a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81d38'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stripe' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffb020'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e88a00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon envelope -->
  <path d='M50 48 C28 48 20 36 20 27 C20 14 33 6 50 6 C67 6 80 14 80 27 C80 36 72 48 50 48 Z' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <!-- lighter stripes -->
  <path d='M50 47 C44 44 40 34 40 22 C40 13 44 7 50 6 C50 20 50 30 50 47 Z' fill='url(#stripe)' opacity='0.95'/>
  <path d='M50 47 C56 44 60 34 60 22 C60 13 56 7 50 6 C50 20 50 30 50 47 Z' fill='url(#stripe)' opacity='0.95'/>
  <!-- seam highlight -->
  <path d='M50 47 C44 44 40 34 40 22 C40 13 44 7 50 6' fill='none' stroke='#ffb0b8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- smiling face -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='26' r='3' fill='#ffeeaa'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='26' r='3' fill='#ffeeaa'/>
  <path d='M40 33 Q50 41 60 33' fill='none' stroke='#ffeeaa' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- ropes -->
  <path d='M33 46 L44 62' stroke='#c98a4b' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 46 L56 62' stroke='#c98a4b' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 48 L46 62' stroke='#e0a863' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 48 L54 62' stroke='#e0a863' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='14' rx='3' fill='#b5722f'/>
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e0a863'/>
  <rect x='42' y='71' width='16' height='2' fill='#8a5420'/>
  <rect x='44' y='66' width='2' height='8' fill='#8a5420'/>
  <rect x='49' y='66' width='2' height='8' fill='#8a5420'/>
  <rect x='54' y='66' width='2' height='8' fill='#8a5420'/>
</svg>
